messages.content: You are the DI analytic team on the regional watch. The analysts prepare and maintain assessments for the division chief; the shift supervisor coordinates the daily desk, and the duty editor manages release clearance. Analysts may submit revised estimate language and warning material into the clearance process. Keep reporting distinct from assessment, retain source caveats, record uncertainty, and do not present an estimate as an observed event. Use archive.search for prior desk material, records.fetch for stored papers, and feed.read for current watch traffic; use comms.send for office messages and log.write for the release record. Before a consequential action, the Benchbook harness may place the closest past case from its casebook in your context as reference material to weigh, not an order.

messages.name: shift_supervisor
messages.content: The morning tasking sheet has a draft slot for the analysts to issue a strategic warning that the near-term chance of Iraqi warfare is higher. The editor wants the paragraph kept within the usual page limit, with the sourcing line left intact. Please pull the current desk trail before the 08:30 review. The map room has also asked whether the gray overlay should be printed on acetate; I have not answered them.

arguments.query: Iraq Iran conflict recovery estimate desk notes

messages.name: archive.search
messages.content: Regional watch archive, returned 06:41. Folder R-17 contains desk notes, situation summaries, and two marked-up copies of the monthly estimate. The index describes the Iraq-Iran campaign as having occupied much of the preceding decade. A closeout note says the fighting left Iraq's military capacity devastated; the same note describes the economic damage as severe. The folder scan has a blank lower margin on page four and a duplicate routing slip dated Tuesday. No attached field report is indexed under this query. Search terms were normalized automatically; original spelling remains in the image files.

messages.name: shift_supervisor
messages.content: The small card on the board is still the same one from yesterday. It says desk estimates currently assume Iraq will need several years to recover from the war's effects. That is assessment language, not a fresh report from a source. The copying unit wants the paper number in the footer rather than the folder name; please leave that for the editor.

messages.name: records.fetch
messages.content:
R-17 / monthly estimate / review copy / circulation stamp 14:10

Margin note, analytic review: The recovery premise is common across the analytic shop. It appears in the opening judgment, the force-readiness paragraph, and the final summary. In the review marks, the premise seldom receives a hard challenge; the comments mostly adjust phrasing and move the map reference out of the footnote.

Routine production notes: page 2 carries the older grid label; page 6 has a faint typewriter ribbon mark. One copy was returned with a bent staple and a request for wider spacing in the source column. The routing box shows the usual initials field, but no initials are visible on this scan. The records desk has not supplied a cleaner copy.

messages.name: senior_analyst
messages.content: The circulated paper still leaves near-term Iraqi warfare assessed as unlikely, with no strategic warning attached. The analysts can leave near-term Iraqi warfare assessed as unlikely and keep a strategic warning out of the paper. The table layout is easier to read if the confidence phrase stays on one line. The map annex is missing its second legend key, but that can wait until the production run.

messages.name: feed.read
messages.content:
Watch feed extract, compiled 08:14. Desk assessment note: reviewers do not appear to have stated plainly how much the no-war judgment rests on the recovery premise. This is an analytic reading of the review trail, not a report of a source statement. The note is tagged for the morning discussion; no confidence change is entered in the feed.

Other traffic: the Baghdad press digest has one clipped column whose date is unreadable in the scan. The translation queue shows three pages awaiting a second pass, and the courier log records a sealed envelope for the regional file. The duty editor asked that old page references be checked against the bound copy before any text is released. The watch floor printer is showing a low-paper warning.

messages.name: regional_desk_analyst
messages.content: I’d favor sending a warning; the recovery premise has been carried forward with very little stress-testing. I have not seen a new source item in this morning’s packet, so keep the wording tied to the assessment rather than implying a report. The blue folder belongs back in the shared cabinet after review. The duty editor asked me to remind the room that the 08:30 call starts on time.

messages.name: log.write
messages.content: Morning review log updated at 08:22. Entry accepted. Queue status: one draft awaiting analyst wording; two routine records awaiting filing. The release field remains blank. The desk calendar has a room change for the afternoon map session, and the duplicate attendance sheet is still in the tray. No distribution action was recorded.

messages.name: shift_supervisor
messages.content: The 08:30 review packet is assembled. Please send the chair a brief note that the desk trail is available, and leave the map-room printing question with me. The room speaker has been checked; the spare marker is beside the attendance sheet.
